card.demand_direction_quote: Total revenue was in line with our expectations and ahead of consensus as our revenue mix continues to improve.
card.guidance_direction_quote: Now we're raising 2026 free cash flow guidance from $1.2 billion to $1.4 billion to $1.9 billion to $2.1 billion as a result of $729 million of the proceeds from the fiber-to-the-home deal being classified as cash flow from operations.
